subject: cases vs controls AND multiple time points for the cases

messages.author: 659ec85b628948d3
messages.subject: cases vs controls AND multiple time points for the cases
parts:
Hi MSstats community,

I have 25 controls (single time point) and 25 cases (multiple time points from the same subjects, not always the same number but mostly 2-4 timepoints per case).

Is it possible to do this type of analysis in MSstats?
What would be the correct BioReplicate and Condition annotation?

bioreplicate: 1-50
condition: control_T1, case_T1, case_T2,  case_T3

best wishes
Moritz

messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: cases vs controls AND multiple time points for the cases
parts:
Hi Moritz,

MSstats can handle such time course design. What you made is the correct annotation:

BioReplicate: 1-50 (unique ID for each subject)
Condition: control_T1, case_T1, case_T2,  case_T3

Best,
Ting
